_about: Runtime hair physics for SK_Voidreign (tools/Create-VoidreignHairPhysics.py). One AnimDynamics chain per mane/tail strand in a post-process AnimBP; overrides the baked SEC bone keys. Angles in degrees, lengths in cm. Each chain simulates relative to its parent bone (third entry), so body/head motion carries the hair rigidly and only sim_space_angular_alpha of that bone's rotation is fed back as inertia; component-space simulation flailed under the rear/attack clips.
